Purchased Voltas 1.5 ton 3 star 2026 model AC on Prime Day Sale 2026. Got a very favorable deal with exchange of my 10 years old Hitachi 1 ton AC (working condition). Delivery by Amazon was on the day (Sunday), as I had selected. Delivery and acceptance (pick up) of my old AC by Amazon was very smooth. After delivery within 2 hours received call from Technician for installation on Sunday itself. Technicians came on time and completed installation within 2 hours. Technicians were very thorough on the job. Installation charges taken from me Rs.1650/-, though on Amazon it was declared as Rs.1399/-. Technicians told that Rs.1650/- is the standard installation charges for all split ACs. During installation, technicians has shown the Copper wires inside Compressor (Outdoor) unit and Air filters in Indoor unit. Not expected such prompt and good service in a city like Jammu. Using the AC since last 3 days and felt comfortable. Noise level not at all noticeable. Airflow is fair enough to cool down my 160 Sqft room in 10 minutes. Fully satisfied with product. It is a budget friendly AC. Must be recommended to others.

reviews.review_title: Strong Unpleasant Smell from Brand-New AC – Request for Replacement
reviews.review_comment: Brief content visible, double tap to read full content. Full content visible, double tap to read brief content. The brand-new AC started producing a strong and unpleasant smell after running continuously for about two hours. Since the AC was brand new and the issue persisted, I requested a replacement. However, the Voltas service team replaced the coil, but the problem still has not been resolved. The AC continues to produce a very bad smell even after the coil replacement. I again requested a replacement, but Voltas refused to replace the product and offered only a refund. What is even more disappointing is that Voltas has not agreed to refund the installation charges. We spent money on installation and also put in considerable effort to clean and prepare the room for installing a brand-new AC. Due to the product issue and the poor service experience, all of this effort and expense has gone to waste. Voltas has completely failed to provide a proper solution or satisfactory resolution to the customer. After multiple attempts to resolve the issue, the only option being offered is a refund, without adequately considering the inconvenience, time, effort, and additional expenses caused to the customer. Based on my experience, I strongly recommend that customers think twice before purchasing this product. A brand-new AC should not have such a serious issue, and the service team should provide a proper replacement or effective resolution instead of leaving the customer to deal with repeated problems. This has been a very disappointing experience with both the product quality and Voltas customer service. The company has completely failed to provide a satisfactory resolution, and the customer is left bearing the inconvenience and installation-related expenses despite the product being defective.

He asked me to pay ₹4,000 and said that ₹5,500 would be considered for my old AC. I want new AC so i paid 4000 Rs to delivey person and taken New LG AC. The installation experience was even worse. product_details.description: LG Split AC: New 2026 BEE Standards for Ultra-Cooling & Bigger Savings! Stay perfectly chilled and save on bills with cooling built for extreme climate. Cools at 55°C Even at a blistering 55°C, LG Split Air Conditioners flip the script. Built for India’s harshest summers, LG delivers effortless cooling while ordinary ACs struggle to keep up with the heat. 100% Hi-Grooved Copper Pipes Hi-Grooved Copper pipes serve dual benefits of better heat dissipation of refrigerant & increasing the durability of pipe. Viraat Mode Boosts cooling up to 124% for instant relief on the hottest days. *Actual power consumption may vary based on room size and local climate conditions compared to standard test results. AI Convertible: Smart cooling tailored to your comfort and savings. Durable design meets high-performance engineering for lasting reliability. Low Gas Detection New Low Gas Detection automatically detects, notifies and switches off AC for safety. ADC Sensors Integrated safety sensors and parameter checks ensure robust, secure operation. This design ensure high durability and stable performance at every step, keeping your AC safe and reliable. Gold Fin+ A corrosion resistant coating for increased durability of your LG Air Conditioner. #Tested by TUV Rheinland. GoldFin+ comes with outdoor unit of 2024 onwards series of Split AC’s. Ocean Black Protection LG’s Ocean Black Protection ensures the Split Air Conditioner is protected against all-weather conditions. Stabilizer Free Plus Compressor is the most important component of an Air Conditioner. LG’s enhanced stabilizer-free plus operation prevents voltage fluctuations without compromising on the safety, savings and comfort. Intuitively designed for seamless operation and ultimate convenience. Diet Mode+ Diet Mode+ uses Smart Inverter tech to slash power by 75% while boosting airflow. This one-touch setting optimizes efficiency and comfort, making it easy to manage costs without losing cooling. Mute Function Tired of loud AC beeps? With LG, a 3-second long press of the Diet button silences all alerts. Experience quiet, peaceful cooling and uninterrupted sleep at the touch of a button. Instant AC troubleshooting via phone Smart Diagnosis Via Smartphone Change the way you think, get smart things done when you have the ThinQ App around. Conveniently check and troubleshoot Air Conditioner related problems directly from your smartphone. Advanced air purification meets high-performance cooling for a healthier home. Auto Clean Eliminates bacteria through constantly drying up the heat exchanger, that also helps keep off bad odor. Refrigerant R32 LG’s Air Conditioner uses Refrigerant R32 which has zero ODP & lower GWP compared to other refrigerants. HimClean Keeps your indoor environment healthier with automated freezing technology that thoroughly cleans the evaporator and drainage system for fresher air. HD Filter with Anti-Virus Protection Filters and eliminates harmful airborne viruses, bacteria, dust, pollen, and allergens, ensuring a clean, healthy indoor environment. Monsoon Comfort Monsoon Comfort Technology for comfortable cooling and greater power savings even in humid conditions.
